risks.if_unproven: priced as condition unverified, i.e. as if leaking/not confirmed watertight

risks.proof: Photo of the base and the outlet/tap area
risks.if_unproven: priced as if tap/fitting missing and needing replacement

proof_requests: Close-up of any molded capacity marking or size sticker on the tank
Photo of the base and outlet/tap fitting
Photo of the lid removed and refitted
A fresh dated photo/video of this specific tank with today's date visible
A short video of water being poured in or tank being tapped to check for leaks or cracks
response.reason: Brand is clearly legible as Geepee and the item is a standard used plastic water storage tank, but the claimed 2500L capacity and sound/leak-free condition are unverifiable from the photos, so it must be priced at the worst-case smaller size and unconfirmed condition until capacity marking and condition proof are provided.
